description: Install dependencies and set up shadcn/ui design system foundation for the web app. Establish the Netflix-inspired design token system in Tailwind config that both web components and mobile will reference for color consistency.
steps: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun install` to set up existing dependencies
Install shadcn/ui dependencies: `bun add class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge` (these are the core utilities shadcn/ui components use)

Create `apps/web/src/lib/utils.js` with the standard shadcn/ui cn() utility: import { clsx } from 'clsx'; import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge'; export function cn(...inputs) { return twMerge(clsx(inputs)); }

Rewrite `apps/web/tailwind.config.js` with a Netflix-inspired design token palette: background: { DEFAULT: '#141414', elevated: '#1a1a1a', card: '#181818' }, foreground: '#FFFFFF', muted: { DEFAULT: '#808080', foreground: '#b3b3b3' }, primary: { DEFAULT: '#E50914', hover: '#F40612' }, ring: '#E50914', border: '#333333'. Also add proper container, fontFamily (Inter), and the shimmer keyframe.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/index.css` with Netflix-inspired base styles: dark background #141414, white text, scrollbar-hide utility, shimmer animation, and add CSS custom properties matching the tokens for potential future use.
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build` to verify the foundation compiles cleanly
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && bun install` to set up mobile dependencies
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/node_modules exists and bun install succeeds
shadcn/ui utilities (class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge) are in package.json dependencies
apps/web/src/lib/utils.js exports a working cn() function
tailwind.config.js has Netflix-inspired color tokens (red primary #E50914, dark backgrounds #141414/#181818)
bun run build succeeds with 0 errors
bun run lint passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings
bun run typecheck passes with 0 errors
apps/mobile/node_modules exists and bun install succeeds
